question: Litmus paper changes to ______ colour when put in soap water.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Blue.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Litmus paper changes to a** blue ****colour** when put in soap water.
 
• Indicators are the substances that are used to identify whether the given substance is an acid or a base.
 
• There are two types of indicators:
 
• **Natural:**
 
 
• These indicators are obtained from natural sources like plants.
 
• Turmeric, litmus, china rose petals, etc., are some of the naturally occurring indicators.
 
• The most commonly used natural indicator is litmus.
 
• It is extracted from lichens.
 
• It is available in the form of a solution, or in the form of strips of paper, known as litmus paper.
 
 
 
• **Man-made:**
 
 
• Phenolphthalein, Methyl orange are some of the man-made indicators.
